chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed Asr with the people, so he shortened the two final cycles. When he finished, the people said to him, 'Did something happen during the prayer?' He said, 'And what is that?' They said, 'You shortened the two final cycles.' So he said to them, 'Did you not hear the child crying?'
ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet shorten the last two rak'ahs of Dhuhr prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith illustrates the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) practical application of mercy (rahma) by shortening the Dhuhr prayer upon hearing a child's cry, a practice later codified in Shia jurisprudence as a recommended act (mustahabb) to alleviate the child's distress. It underscores the principle that religious rituals should accommodate human needs, particularly the vulnerability of children, reflecting the broader Islamic ethic of compassion in communal worship.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Abdullah Bin Sinan,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said; ‘Rasool-Allahsaww Prayed Al-Zohr with the people, so hesaww lightened during the two last Cycles. So when hesaww finished, the people said to himsaww, ‘Did an event occur during the Prayer?’ Hesaww said: ‘And what is that?’ They said, ‘Yousaww lightened the last two Cycles’. So hesaww said to them: ‘But, you heard the child screaming’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, once performed Salat (prayer) of al-Zuhr with people and made the two last Rak’at light. When he (the Messenger of Allah) completed, people asked if something has happened during Salat (prayer). He (the Messenger of Allah) asked, ‘Why do you ask such question?’ They replied, ‘You made the last two Rak’at light.’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘Did you not hear crying of the child?”’
